text:
elaine: Quick follow-up on the authz postmortem. Short recap: a rotated service-account token was briefly reused by an older pod image and an audit_forwarder outage dropped token_validation rows. We need owners, a short mitigation, and a plan to surface recurrence patterns.
mark: I can own audit detection + dashboarding. I'll add a panel that highlights gaps and correlate with forwarder restarts. ETA: 2026-04-12.
carlos: I'll own the secrets/runbook side. Plan: produce a verified rotation run in prod with on-call, and update the deploy checklist to force pod drains when secrets change. ETA: 2026-04-11.
ops-bot: Created issue SEC-2026-1477 and subtasks. Link: http://tracker.internal/SEC-2026-1477
elaine: Minimal mitigation for tonight: add a temporary SaaS rule to reject tokens older than 10m that were not observed in validation logs, and raise an alert if audit_forwarder_down > 0 for 2m.
mark: Proposed query to detect missing rows by minute: ```sql
SELECT service, date_trunc('minute', ts) AS minute, count(*) AS rows
FROM audit_logs
WHERE event='token_validation' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY service, minute
ORDER BY minute DESC;
```
mark: I'll also add an ML-style trend: count of incidents with missing rows per 30d window to the postmortem doc.
carlos: Rotation checklist I'm using (compact): 1) create new key in HSM/KMS, 2) update k8s secret, 3) annotate deployment for graceful drain, 4) rolling restart, 5) run smoke validate + collect evidence bundle. Smoke command: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://auth.redwood.example/v1/validate | jq .ok
```
elaine: Owners & deadlines: mark - audit/dash/alerts (due 2026-04-12), carlos - rotate & runbook + evidence (due 2026-04-11), elaine - postmortem write-up + trend analysis (due 2026-04-14). ops-bot, please create subtasks with these owners.
ops-bot: Subtasks created: 1477-A audit-dashboard (owner:mark, due:2026-04-12), 1477-B rotate-verify (owner:carlos, due:2026-04-11), 1477-C postmortem-trends (owner:elaine, due:2026-04-14).
mark: Draft Grafana alert: expr = sum(rate(audit_log_miss_total{service="auth"}[5m])) by (service) / sum(rate(audit_log_total{service="auth"}[5m])) by (service) > 0.001 -> page. PR will reference SEC-2026-1477.
carlos: I'll attach a rotation runbook link + evidence bundle to the tracker after prod canary. Will include the k8s annotation used to force drain: `redwood.com/drain=true`.
elaine: Also recommend a weekly "post-deploy token smoke" job that runs after any deploy and records validation results in a short-lived index; escalate if failures found. Mark, can you include this metric in the dashboard?
mark: Yep. I'll add a Prometheus metric `postdeploy_token_smoke_failures_total` and a grafana panel.
sec-bot: Reminder: include compliance evidence (signed manifest + logs) in SEC-2026-1477 before closing.
carlos: Staging rotation done; smoke passed. Scheduling prod rotation tonight 23:00 UTC with on-call. Will upload evidence link after run.
elaine: Great. Let's also add a short-term rule in the CI pipeline to fail builds if they don't include the `redwood.com/drain=true` annotation on secret updates. That'll enforce the drain step.
mark: Adding a lint rule PR for deploy templates. PR #infra-204 will block merge without annotation.
elaine: Reconvene next Tue at 10:00 to verify evidence and close subtasks. If anyone sees recurring missing rows after rotations, escalate immediately and tag SEC-2026-1477. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
